title: A Hymn for the House
author: Ulyana Whitlock
blurb: Jude Nystrom, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
